_comment: Shopify variant -> Gooten catalog variant. `match` tokens must resolve to EXACTLY ONE variant in gooten-catalog.json (run scripts/gooten-catalog.mjs first); wire-gooten.mjs fails loudly and prints candidates rather than guessing, because Gooten SKU strings are long and near-identical and a silent mismatch prints the wrong garment. Print pixel sizes are NOT declared here — they come from Gooten's own producttemplates response at wire time. Start with one family (--only LUPI-CAF-POST), confirm the sample print, then extend.
